neighbours.label: closing word piece of a famous political leader's multi-token surname (Kag|ame, T|ito, Rich|el|ieu): fires on the piece that completes the name; a split surname of an ordinary person stays low
fire: For three decades Zaire was ruled by the dictator Mobutu, who looted the treasury.
In 1964 Tanzania was formed under the leadership of Julius Nyerere.
After the coup, Chile was governed by General Pinochet until 1990.
The Indonesian army forced President Sukarno to hand over power.
During the 1960s the Soviet leader Brezhnev expanded the military.
Ghana won independence in 1957 under Kwame Nkrumah.
Ethiopia suffered under the regime of Colonel Mengistu for years.
At the Congress of Vienna, the Austrian statesman Metternich shaped Europe.
quiet: For three decades the bakery was run by my uncle Kowalczyk, who loved bread.
In 1964 the school was opened under the leadership of Mrs Pemberton.
After the storm, the shop was managed by Mr Hendrickson until spring.
The local team forced coach Ostrowski to change the lineup.
During the 1960s the village butcher expanded his little shop.
Our street won a garden prize in 1957 thanks to Mrs Pemberton.
The office suffered under the poor management of Mr Kowalczyk for years.
At the county fair, the farmer Hendrickson showed his prize pig.
